Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1054500. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1054500, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
